name: PerformAQuery
label: Performs A Search Query
description: Performs a search query in Salesforce using SOQL-like syntax.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to connect with
fields.description: The credential to connect with (JSON containing InstanceUrl, AccessToken, ApiVersion).

fields.name: Query
fields.label: Query
fields.description: The search query to execute (e.g., 'FIND \"John\" IN Name FIELDS RETURNING Contact')

fields.name: Results
fields.label: Results
fields.description: The list of search results returned as JSON.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response from Salesforce.
